svg.title: Detailed chargeback triage and evidence agent pipeline
svg.desc: A dispute flows through five stages. Triage scores win probability from twelve leak-guarded features. Deterministic retrieval pulls evidence named by a 42-code rulebook. A language model drafts claims constrained to what was retrieved. A verifier applies four checks: artifact exists, kind matches, predates dispute, and covers the rulebook requirement. An expected-value rule then routes each case to accept, submit, or the human queue, and every outcome writes an audit record.
